data.name: SC5_001
data.value: We've made it pretty deep...

data.name: SC5_002
data.value: Is this the deepest section of the tunnel?

data.name: SC5_003
data.value: I would think so,[pause=10] with how hot it's gotten.

data.name: SC5_004
data.value: Urf,[pause=10] I don't know how much more of this heat I can take...

data.name: SC5_005
data.value: Ruff...[pause=0] It's starting to get to me too.[pause=0] I feel like I could melt!

data.name: SC5_006
data.value: Same here...[pause=0] But we don't have much further to go!

data.name: SC5_007
data.value: Let's get through here quickly so we can get out of this heat and to the next camp.

data.name: SC5_008
data.value: Waaah![pause=0] Wh-what!?[pause=0] Tremors!?

data.name: SC5_009
data.value: W-woah![pause=0] That was close![pause=0] Is everyone OK!?

data.name: SC5_010
data.value: We're fine,[pause=10] ruff![pause=0] But...

data.name: SC5_011
data.value: What are we gonna do now?[pause=0] The lava's in our way!

data.name: SC5_012
data.value: The lava is volatile in this place,[pause=10] right?[pause=0]\nIt shifts around and moves all over the place!

data.name: SC5_013
data.value: If we wait,[pause=10] the lava flow might change and clear the way forward.

data.name: SC5_014
data.value: I just hope it doesn't take long,[pause=10] this heat is unbearable!

data.name: SC5_015
data.value: I guess we have no choice.[pause=0] We'll have to wait and hope the lava goes away.

data.name: SC5_016
data.value: ...Outlanders...[pause=0] Is this your doing?

data.name: SC5_017
data.value: Huh?[pause=0] Did you guys hear that?

data.name: SC5_018
data.value: Ruff?[pause=0] No,[pause=10] I didn't hear anything.

data.name: SC5_019
data.value: I didn't hear anything either.

data.name: SC5_020
data.value: Wh-what!?[pause=0] Who said that?

data.name: SC5_021
data.value: You trepass on our land and cause turmoil,[pause=10] yet have the gall to question who we are!?

data.name: SC5_022
data.value: Fine![pause=0] So be it![pause=0] We shall show you who we are!

data.name: SC5_023
data.value: Waaah![pause=0] Where did these guys come from!?

data.name: SC5_024
data.value: Th-they're {0}![pause=0] Their bodies are made up of hot magma!

data.name: SC5_025
data.value: They must have been in the lava coursing underneath this pit!

data.name: SC5_026
data.value: They don't look friendly,[pause=10] ruff...

data.name: SC5_027
data.value: H-hey![pause=0] We don't want to fight!

data.name: SC5_028
data.value: We're just passing through here![pause=0] We don't mean to trespass or cause any trouble!

data.name: SC5_029
data.value: No trouble!?[pause=0] You lie to us as well!?

data.name: SC5_030
data.value: All you outlanders coming through here,[pause=10] disrupting the balance of this place...

data.name: SC5_031
data.value: It makes my blood boil with rage![pause=0] That tears it!

data.name: SC5_032
data.value: I am {0}![pause=0] Chieftain of the {1} clan!

data.name: SC5_033
data.value: No mercy for those who defile our home![pause=0] Prepare yourselves,[pause=10] outlanders!

data.name: SC5_034
data.value: You return!?[pause=0] Why must you outlanders continue to bring unrest to our home!?

data.name: SC5_035
data.value: This is a misunderstanding![pause=0] We'd never do something to hurt your home!

data.name: SC5_036
data.value: Ruff![pause=0] That's right![pause=0] We only want to pass through here!

data.name: SC5_037
data.value: Save your lies![pause=0] Outlanders are not to be trusted!

data.name: SC5_038
data.value: Prepare for another scorching!

data.name: SC5_039
data.value: Gwooaaaaaaah!

data.name: SC5_040
data.value: Outlanders...[pause=0] Your strength...[pause=0] We are outmatched.

data.name: SC5_041
data.value: You have bested our clan.[pause=0] Do what you will with us.

data.name: SC5_042
data.value: What are you talking about?[pause=0] We don't want to hurt you!

data.name: SC5_043
data.value: Yeah![pause=0] We only fought you because you attacked us.[pause=0] We just want to pass through here!

data.name: SC5_044
data.value: ...[pause=30]Mercy?[pause=0] You give us mercy in our moment of vulnerability?

data.name: SC5_045
data.value: Outlanders...[pause=0] I do not know what to say.

data.name: SC5_046
data.value: Your forgiveness...[pause=0] it speaks volumes.[pause=0] I see now that you never harbored any ill will towards my clan.

data.name: SC5_047
data.value: We were wrong to attack you.[pause=0] On behalf of my clan,[pause=10] I offer my sincerest apologies.

data.name: SC5_048
data.value: It's alright,[pause=10] we're all squared away now right?

data.name: SC5_049
data.value: But I have to ask...[pause=0] Why did you attack us in the first place?[pause=0] Did we do something wrong?

data.name: SC5_050
data.value: ...Our clan has suffered great tragedy at the hands of outlanders in days gone past.

data.name: SC5_051
data.value: Between the horrible fluctuations in the lava flow and all the other outlanders passing through here today...

data.name: SC5_052
data.value: ...I thought this was a return to those times.

data.name: SC5_053
data.value: Huh?[pause=0] Fluctuations in the lava flow?

data.name: SC5_054
data.value: Historically,[pause=10] the lava flowing through this tunnel has been stable and steady.

data.name: SC5_055
data.value: All sorts of Pokémon,[pause=10] Fire-type or not,[pause=10] have been able to call this place home.

data.name: SC5_056
data.value: But recently,[pause=10] the lava flow has become irregular.

data.name: SC5_057
data.value: Unpredictably,[pause=10] sections of the tunnel overflow with lava,[pause=10] driving out the less heat-resistant Pokémon.

data.name: SC5_058
data.value: Meanwhile,[pause=10] other sections dry up,[pause=10] leaving those such as ourselves feeling cold and numb.

data.name: SC5_059
data.value: The inconsistency has been very stressful for every Pokémon living in this place.

data.name: SC5_060
data.value: When the lava flow erupted as you outlanders passed through...[pause=0] I figured you were the culprits.

data.name: SC5_061
data.value: But given your mercy towards our clan,[pause=10] it is clear you are not to blame for this.[pause=0] It was merely a coincidence.

data.name: SC5_062
data.value: So that's why you attacked us...

data.name: SC5_063
data.value: But how could we have possibly caused the lava flow to change?[pause=0] We don't have that sort of power!

data.name: SC5_064
data.value: In hindsight...[pause=0] We did act rather rashly.

data.name: SC5_065
data.value: But please understand that our behavior was guided by agitation and mistrust rather than logic.

data.name: SC5_066
data.value: All we can do now is allow you safe passage through the remainder of the cavern.

data.name: SC5_067
data.value: I apologize again.

data.name: SC5_068
data.value: We will be on our way now.[pause=0] Safe travels,[pause=10] outlanders.

data.name: SC5_069
data.value: Did he need to exit so dramatically...?

data.name: SC5_070
data.value: Phew![pause=0] What a tense situation![pause=0] Thank goodness it's over with!

data.name: SC5_071
data.value: Yeah,[pause=10] that was a scary scene![pause=0] Things could have gone badly for us!

data.name: SC5_072
data.value: I'm just glad you were here, {0} and {1}.

data.name: SC5_073
data.value: I don't think we could've make them come to their senses if it was just me and {0}!

data.name: SC5_074
data.value: Same![pause=0] We would have been in trouble if you guys weren't here,[pause=10] ruff!

data.name: SC5_075
data.value: Hmm.[pause=0] So the tunnel's lava hasn't always been like how it is now...

data.name: SC5_076
data.value: I wonder what's causing the issue then?

data.name: SC5_077
data.value: I don't know...[pause=0] What could even cause something like that?

data.name: SC5_078
data.value: Whatever it is,[pause=10] it doesn't seem natural...[pause=0] Could a Pokémon be behind it?

data.name: SC5_079
data.value: Wait,[pause=10] forget about the lava![pause=0] How long have we been in this tunnel for?

data.name: SC5_080
data.value: Oh no![pause=0] We got held up by {0} and his clan![pause=0] It's got to be late by now!

data.name: SC5_081
data.value: Ruff![pause=0] We've got to hurry to the next base camp before nightfall![pause=0] Come on,[pause=10] ruff!

data.name: SC5_082
data.value: The instability...[pause=0] Outlanders...[pause=0] It must be your doing!

data.name: SC5_083
data.value: ({0} seemed to think so,[pause=10] given that he accused us...)

data.name: SC5_084
data.value: (Obviously he was wrong,[pause=10] but...[pause=0] Could a Pokémon even be causing this?[pause=0] It's hard to imagine one that powerful...)
